Scene: Euro coin beside a clear 100 and small cent coins.

Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
Attached image is STYLE/LAYOUT reference only. Use the new scene and exact supplied teaching text. Cream/gold heading, bold navy typography, gold memory caption, pale blue example strip, warm editorial photo. Accurate Swedish å ä ö, readable text fully inside margins. One square image.
